definitions: A number of places in Canada.
A number of places in the United States.

blocks.text: Lakeville is a community in the Canadian province of New Brunswick. This small village is located between Centreville and Woodstock. It is located on Route 560 in Carleton County. It has two churches, a convenience store, a post office, a fire hall, a park, and a community center. In the center of this village is the Williamstown Lake.
